lines.text: Access control keycard installations require single sign-on authentication.
SAML single sign-on will be live within fourteen days of contract signing.
We have five distinct escalation workflows for security clearance audits.
We will configure up to ten custom workflows within fourteen days.
Can the field app scan legacy magnetic swipe badges directly?
We could look into integrating with legacy magnetic badges, but that is speculative.
That is fine, the mobile barcodes and SSO meet our standard.
